user.title: MAST Water Meter — Setup
user.description: Enter the phone number registered with your MAST account. An SMS with a verification code will be sent to you. Alternatively, paste a JWT token directly to skip OTP.

otp.title: Verification Code
otp.description: An SMS was sent to {secured_phone}. Enter the 6-digit code.

reauth_phone.title: MAST — Re-authenticate
reauth_phone.description: Your login token has expired. Re-verify with your phone number, or paste a new JWT token directly.

reauth_otp.title: Verification Code — Re-authentication
reauth_otp.description: An SMS was sent to {secured_phone}. Enter the code.

error.invalid_auth: Failed to send SMS — check that the phone number is registered with your MAST account.
error.invalid_otp: Incorrect or expired verification code. Please try again.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Check your internet connection.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.
error.phone_required: Phone number is required when not providing a manual JWT token.

abort.already_configured: MAST Water Meter is already configured.
